goal:
Create the ShredBoost AudioProcessor shell in Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp. This is the buildable scaffold for a C++20 JUCE plugin; DSP modules are added in later phases.

Requirements:
- Declare class ShredBoostAudioProcessor : public juce::AudioProcessor.
- Implement isBusesLayoutSupported() to accept exactly: mono-in/mono-out, mono-in/stereo-out, and stereo-in/stereo-out; reject all other layouts.
- In processBlock(): instantiate juce::ScopedNoDenormals at the very top; deterministically clear every output channel that has no corresponding input channel (loop from getTotalNumInputChannels() to getTotalNumOutputChannels() and call buffer.clear(channel, 0, buffer.getNumSamples())). Perform NO heap allocation, locking, file IO, string construction, GUI calls, or buffer resizing inside processBlock.
- Provide standard AudioProcessor overrides: getName() returns "ShredBoost", prepareToPlay(), releaseResources(), acceptsMidi()/producesMidi() false, isMidiEffect() false, getTailLengthSeconds() 0.0, program methods, getStateInformation()/setStateInformation() stubs, hasEditor() true, and createEditor() (a forward declaration for the editor created in a.2 — return nullptr placeholder is acceptable only if a compile-safe forward is not yet available; prefer declaring createEditor and defining it minimally). Include createPluginFilter() factory returning a new ShredBoostAudioProcessor.

Before editing, inspect:
- ./JUCE/modules/juce_audio_processors/juce_audio_processors.h for the AudioProcessor interface (do NOT modify anything under JUCE/).
- The plan product identity: plugin name ShredBoost, vendor nSpace Systems.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.

goal:
Create the minimal ShredBoost editor shell in Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp, connected to the processor created in a.1.

Requirements:
- Declare class ShredBoostAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor, holding a reference to ShredBoostAudioProcessor.
- Constructor takes ShredBoostAudioProcessor& and calls setSize() with a reasonable default (e.g. 600x400) and setResizable(true, true).
